{{Top|leg}}
A '''gas gun''' was a type of [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]], designed to dispense various types of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] into the area immediately surrounding the user. While it was ineffective in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or against opponents wearing [[Environment suit/Legends|environmental suit]], the gas gun was particularly effective aboard small [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. [[Kin Laron]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], installed such a gas gun in her modified [[Zero-G stormtrooper armor]]. She typically loaded it with different gases, ranging from [[stun gas]] to [[Poison gas/Legends|poison]] and contact [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxins]].<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
